## Required formal completion

2. For initial UNC require exact equality among requested, resolved, completed,

3. Bind one reproducible exact arithmetic authority for coefficient mass,

5. Type effective Monte Carlo information by estimator, target, domain,

7. Close exact source/profile/Registry bindings and create one superseding

8. Preserve stable r0.3 IDs; append only genuinely new clauses and predictions.

## Scientific-author exact arithmetic selection

Under item 3, the implementation-blind scientific-contract author selects the
following complete representation for the proposed final contract:

- every design-facing `a_pi` and `tau_h` is supplied as a canonical reduced
  rational pair `(n,q)` with arbitrary-precision integers, `q>0`,
  `gcd(abs(n),q)=1`, and zero represented only as `(0,1)`;
- admitted `a_pi` has `n>0`; `tau_h` has `0<=n<q`;
- canonical serialization is signed decimal numerator, ASCII slash, unsigned
  decimal denominator, with no leading plus sign or leading zero except zero;
- `beta_d` and stratum totals are accumulated by exact rational arithmetic in
  stable scientific identity order and reduced canonically;
- sign admission compares nonnegative rational sides by exact arbitrary-
  precision integer cross multiplication; and
- a coefficient or tolerance lacking this exact canonical representation makes
  numerical design resolution unavailable.

This author selection defines proposed r0.4 bytes. It is not implementation
conformity, numerical validation, calibration, or final freeze approval.
